::: {.lead}
Separate organizational and Tribal authorities must be identified.
:::

## What is publicly documented

::: {.case-evidence}
CFMC is a community-based nonprofit whose stated mission connects cultural burning on the Yurok Reservation and ancestral lands with ecosystem health, protection, hunting and gathering.
:::

Sources: [Cultural Fire Management Council: Cultural Fire Management Council](https://www.culturalfire.org/). 

## Relationship status

Potential learning relationship.

## A proposed question to discuss

What would practitioners choose to share about sustaining cultural fire, teaching, access and community-defined outcomes?

This question was drafted for the prototype.

## A possible learning contribution

Learn from practitioner-defined purposes and the institutional work that enables them.

## What remains context-specific

CFMC and Yurok Tribal government are not interchangeable authorities.
